text: Salam, writing about my stepdaughter, she's 5. Temp is 38.1, I think, checked under the arm so maybe a bit off. She hadn't done a poo for three days and was grumpy with all of us about it, wallah moody all day. Then tonight it came out runny. She's still drinking fine though and weeing like normal, I'd say. Her neck isn't stiff, she can put her chin down on her chest no problem, I checked. There are some red spots on her arms and legs but they're mosquito bites from the garden yesterday, little raised itchy bumps, she's been scratching them. Not sure if any of this matters together, just wanted to check. Shukran.
